name: techlead
description: Turns a product idea into PRD, SPEC, PLAN, TASKS, AGENTS, and README with milestones, issue-ready tasks, Docker environments, and a test coverage gate of at least 80 percent.

interface.shortDescription: Turn an idea into a complete, issue-ready engineering plan
interface.longDescription: Run a structured brainstorming interview, capture every decision, and produce PRD.md, SPEC.md, PLAN.md, TASKS.md, AGENTS.md, and README.md. The plan includes launch milestones, GitHub and GitLab issue automation, local and production Docker environments, security hardening, and a definition of done that requires at least 80 percent test coverage.
defaultPrompt: Turn this idea into PRD.md, SPEC.md, PLAN.md, TASKS.md, AGENTS.md, and README.md with TechLead
Interview me and write a product requirements document plus an engineering specification
Break my milestones into issue-ready tasks for GitHub or GitLab
